# RustDAW - Complete LLM Reference Document

## Project Overview
**RustDAW** - Open-source Digital Audio Workstation written in Rust. Workspace with 7 crates + root package.

**Current Status (2026-10-24):** Fully functional DAW with:
- Step sequencer (16 steps) with click-to-add notes
- Sampler integration (load WAV, trigger on steps)
- Effects chain (LPF → Delay → Reverb) with GUI controls
- Polyphonic synthesis (voice pool with stealing, 1-32 voices)
- Project save/load (JSON) + WAV export
- Windows x64 installer (NSIS)

---

## Workspace Structure

```
/home/rossini/rustdaw/
├── Cargo.toml              # Workspace manifest (7 members)
├── README.md               # Project docs
├── src/main.rs             # Root binary (stub - prints "Hello, world!")
├── analyze.rs              # Standalone WAV analysis tool (RMS per 125ms window)
├── demo_pattern.wav        # Generated test output (4s, stereo, 44.1kHz, f32)
├── rustdaw_engine/         # Core audio engine
├── rustdaw_sequencer/      # Step sequencer (16 steps) + piano roll
├── rustdaw_sampler/        # WAV sampler with pitch shifting
├── rustdaw_effects/        # Filter, delay, reverb
├── rustdaw_visualizer/     # Oscilloscope, spectrum analyzer, VU meter (egui)
├── rustdaw_app/            # Main app: audio (cpal) + UI (egui)
├── rustdaw_project/        # Project save/load (JSON) + WAV export
├── installer/              # Windows installer (NSIS)
│   ├── rustdaw_installer.nsi
│   ├── rustdaw_app.exe
│   └── RustDAW-Setup-x64.exe
├── docs/
│   └── llms-full.txt       # THIS FILE
└── target/                 # Build artifacts
```

---

## Crate Dependency Graph

```
rustdaw_app (binary)
  ├── rustdaw_engine
  ├── rustdaw_sequencer
  ├── rustdaw_sampler
  ├── rustdaw_effects
  ├── rustdaw_visualizer
  └── rustdaw_project

rustdaw_sampler → rustdaw_engine (for WAV reader)
rustdaw_project → rustdaw_engine, rustdaw_sequencer, rustdaw_sampler, rustdaw_effects
rustdaw_visualizer → eframe, rustfft, ringbuf
```

---

## Key Entry Points

| Crate | Entry Point | Purpose |
|-------|-------------|---------|
| `rustdaw_app` | `src/main.rs` → `AppState::new()` | Main GUI app (`cargo run --release -p rustdaw_app`) |
| `rustdaw_project` | `DawProject::export_wav()` | Generates `demo_pattern.wav` (4 measures: kick/hat/synth) |
| `analyze.rs` | `cargo run --bin analyze` | Analyzes WAV RMS per 125ms window |

---

## Build / Run Commands

```bash
# Build all (release)
cargo build --release

# Run main app (requires audio feature)
cargo run --release -p rustdaw_app

# Run with audio (needs ALSA dev libs)
cargo run --release -p rustdaw_app --features audio

# Run WAV analysis on demo_pattern.wav
cargo run --bin analyze

# Run tests
cargo test --workspace

# Cross-compile Windows x64
cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p rustdaw_app

# Build Windows installer
cd installer && makensis rustdaw_installer.nsi
```

---

## Audio Feature

The `audio` feature (enabled via `cargo run --release -p rustdaw_app --features audio`) activates:
- CPAL audio output stream
- Real-time audio thread (`AudioGenerator`)
- Sequencer-driven voice/sampler playback

Without the feature, UI runs but audio is silent.

**System dependency:** `sudo apt install libasound2-dev pkg-config`

---

## Key Types by Crate

### rustdaw_engine (Core Audio Engine)
- `Waveform` - Sine, Square, Sawtooth, Triangle, Noise
- `Oscillator` - Basic oscillator with `next_sample()`
- `Adsr` - ADSR envelope with `trigger_on/off()`, `next_sample()`, `envelope_is_releasing()`
- `Voice` - Oscillator + ADSR, implements `AudioProcessor`
- `Mixer` - Multi-channel mixer with master volume
- `OfflineRenderer` - Renders to buffer, writes WAV via `wav::writer`
- `wav::reader` / `wav::writer` - WAV I/O (PCM 16/32-bit)

### rustdaw_sequencer
- `Note { note: u8, velocity: u8 }` - MIDI note
- `Step { note: Option<Note> }` - Single sequencer step
- `StepSequencer { steps: [Step; 16], bpm, steps_per_beat }`
- `PianoRoll { grid: Vec<Vec<u8>>, ticks_per_beat, length_ticks }`

### rustdaw_sampler
- `Sampler { samples, sample_rate, position, pitch, looped }`
- `from_wav(path)` - Loads mono 32-bit float WAV
- `next_sample()` - Returns `Option<f32>` (linear interpolation)
- `trigger()` - Reset position to start

### rustdaw_effects
- `LowPassFilter { fc, fs, prev }` - One-pole LPF
- `Delay { delay_time, feedback, mix, fs, buffer }`
- `Reverb` - Schroeder: 4 comb filters + 4 all-pass filters
- `EffectChain` - LPF → Delay → Reverb (mono-in, stereo-out), all params clamped

### rustdaw_visualizer
- `AudioBuffer { producer, consumer }` - Lock-free ring buffer (split for audio/UI threads)
- `Oscilloscope` - Waveform display
- `SpectrumAnalyzer` - FFT magnitude spectrum (Hann window, smoothing)
- `VuMeter` - Peak + RMS level display

### rustdaw_app (Main App)
- `AppState` - Shared state (Arc<Mutex<>>): playing, bpm, sequencer, master_volume, audio ring buffer, visualizer widgets, samplers, effect params, max_voices
- `AudioGenerator` (audio feature) - Sequencer-driven voice pool + samplers, pushes samples to ring buffer
- `VoicePool` - Polyphonic voice management with stealing (priority: finished > releasing > oldest)
- `run_audio_thread()` - Spawns CPAL output stream

### rustdaw_project
- `DawProject` - Serializable project state (sequencer, piano_roll, master_volume, bpm, notes)
- `save(path)` / `load(path)` - JSON serialization
- `export_wav(path, duration)` - Generates 4-measure pattern (kick/hat/synth) using engine voices

---

## AppState Fields (Shared State)

```rust
pub struct AppState {
    pub playing: AtomicBool,
    pub bpm: f32,
    pub sequencer: StepSequencer,
    pub master_volume: f32,
    pub audio_producer: HeapProd<f32>,
    pub audio_consumer: HeapCons<f32>,
    pub oscilloscope: RefCell<Oscilloscope>,
    pub spectrum_analyzer: RefCell<SpectrumAnalyzer>,
    pub vu_meter: RefCell<VuMeter>,
    pub samplers: SamplerMap,  // HashMap<u8, Arc<Sampler>>
    // Effect params
    pub effect_lpf_cutoff: f32,
    pub effect_delay_time: f32,
    pub effect_delay_feedback: f32,
    pub effect_delay_mix: f32,
    pub effect_reverb_mix: f32,
    pub effect_enabled: bool,
    // Polyphony
    pub max_voices: u32,
}
```

---

## GUI Controls (egui in main.rs)

| Section | Controls |
|---------|----------|
| **Transport** | Play/Stop button, BPM slider (30-300) |
| **Step Sequencer** | Note dropdown (C2-G8), 16 step buttons (click=toggle, right-click=clear) |
| **Master Volume** | Slider (0-100%) |
| **Effects** | Enable checkbox, LPF cutoff (log 20-20k), Delay time/feedback/mix, Reverb mix |
| **Polyphony** | Max Voices slider (1-32) |
| **Project** | Save/Load JSON paths, Export WAV path + duration |
| **Visualizers** | Oscilloscope, Spectrum Analyzer, VU Meter |

---

## Signal Flow (Audio Thread)

```
Sequencer step advance (16 steps/beat)
    ↓
Note change detection (old vs new step)
    ↓
┌─ Sampler (if loaded for MIDI note) → trigger() → next_sample()
└─ VoicePool (synth fallback) → note_on() → Voice (Oscillator + ADSR) → next_sample()
    ↓
Mix all active voices + samplers × master_volume
    ↓
EffectChain (LPF → Delay → Reverb) - parameters synced from AppState per sample
    ↓
Output to CPAL stream + push left channel to visualizer ringbuffer
```

---

## VoicePool Details (Polyphony)

**Location:** `rustdaw_app/src/lib.rs` (audio module)

**Stealing Priority:**
1. Finished voices (`!voice.is_active()`)
2. Releasing voices (`voice.envelope_is_releasing()`)
3. Oldest `trigger_time`

**Methods:**
- `note_on(midi_note, waveform)` - Retrigger existing / reuse finished / steal / add new
- `note_off(midi_note)` - Trigger release on matching voices
- `set_max_voices(n)` - Resize pool dynamically (called every sample from `AppState.max_voices`)
- `next_sample()` → `[f32; 2]` - Sum all active voices

- ✅ **Sequencer UX** - Note dropdown, click-to-toggle, right-click-clear

### Remaining
- **MIDI input**: Zero support (next: `midir` crate)
- **Multi-track**: `Mixer` supports multiple channels, but only 1 voice pool added
- **Piano roll**: Not integrated into UI
- **Sampler limitations**: Only mono 32-bit float WAV

## Windows Installer

**Output:** `installer/RustDAW-Setup-x64.exe` (5.87 MB)

**Contents:**
- `rustdaw_app.exe` (statically linked, no MinGW DLL deps)
- NSIS installer with:
  - Portuguese (BR) + English
  - Admin install to `$PROGRAMFILES64\RustDAW`
  - Start Menu shortcuts (RustDAW + Uninstall)
  - Desktop shortcut
  - Proper uninstaller with registry cleanup
  - 64-bit Windows check

**To build:**
```bash
cargo build --release --target x86_64-pc-windows-gnu -p rustdaw_app
cp target/x86_64-pc-windows-gnu/release/rustdaw_app.exe installer/
cd installer && makensis rustdaw_installer.nsi
```

---

## Debugging Tips

- **Audio not working:** Check ALSA (`aplay -l`), run with `--features audio`
- **Tests flaky:** `test_wav_writer_reader` uses fixed filename - run in isolation
- **Cross-compile issues:** Ensure `mingw-w64` installed, `.cargo/config.toml` has linker
- **GUI not updating:** Check `AppState` mutex locking, ensure `effect_*` params synced in `next_sample()`
